name: blade-runner-aaa-game-talks-alcon-20261115
lines:
سأل آي جي إن (IGN) كوسوف
عن لعبة ضخمة

فأجاب بنعم، وشدد
على أنها لعبة AAA

وأكد أهمية تفاعل اللاعبين
مع عالم السلسلة

آخر لعبة للسلسلة نالت إشادة
صدرت عام 1997

لم تعلن ألكون بعد استوديو
أو منصات أو موعدًا

tried: Blade Runner 2049 official trailer (Warner/Alcon, IGN video page blade-runner-2049-official-trailer, 2017; 640 copy opened at 1 fps, 141 s): letterboxed 2.39:1 (about 800 rows of picture in the 1920x1080 copy, so a 9:16 crop enlarges about 2.4x, over the 2x cap), guns aimed, a fistfight and a burning wreck, voice-over through most of it, and it is the film, not a game

Steam app 1678420 Blade Runner: Enhanced Edition Trailer (appdetails movie 256890144, HLS 1080p30, 193.7 s; 360p copy opened at 1 fps): 4:3 picture pillarboxed, the 1997 cutscenes upscaled and soft, mostly near-black, a text card every 10 to 20 s ('The highly-anticipated remastered edition...', 'Enjoy a unique experience...', 'Interact with familiar faces...'); the few readable stretches are 2 to 4 s; Steam's content notes list violence and sexual insinuation; its sound was not checked once the picture was ruled out

Blade Runner 2099 trailers (Prime Video): only on YouTube and Prime Video (Alcon's news page embeds YouTube 0Dr8I_RyRCg); ign.com/videos/blade-runner-2099-official-trailer answers 404; YouTube downloads are not used (sign-in, 28 Sep rule)
Alcon's own clips: alconent.com/interactive/bladerunner and /news embed YouTube only (cb1n8nc-jMI, 0Dr8I_RyRCg), no direct file

Kept: Alcon's own Blade Runner 2049 stills (2500x1667, crop 938x1667, enlargement 1.15x) and two crops of the Blade Runner: Enhanced Edition key art from the Xbox store (Poster 1440x2160, crop x 895 to 1440, y 370 to 1340 = 545x970, about 1.98x, for the cover (no coat, gun or title in it); SuperHeroArt 1920x1080, crop x 1350 to 1920 = 570x1080, about 1.89x, for line 4), both committed under live/, no weapon or title text inside either crop; Alcon's 1997 noodle-bar image (v3) dropped as upscaled art with visible blocks; the Joi still failed the flat-cover check (73%) as a cover

bed_reason: Stills Reel: no usable motion source (stills_reason: the Blade Runner 2049 trailer opened and ruled out for letterbox past the 2x cap, weapons and voice-over; the Enhanced Edition Steam trailer opened and ruled out for dark, soft, text-card-heavy 1997 video; the 2099 trailers and Alcon's clips exist only as YouTube embeds). The stills carry no sound, so our bed plays under them and the jingle on the end card.

angle.hook: the company that owns Blade Runner says a big-budget AAA game is being discussed, in the words of its own co-CEO
angle.why_now: Andrew Kosove gave the answer to IGN in an interview ahead of the Blade Runner 2099 series on Prime Video on 25 November, at a time when the franchise has had no acclaimed new game since Westwood's 1997 adventure and the Annapurna project Labyrinth has been delisted
angle.what_it_means_here: for players in the Gulf it is an intention, not a game: no studio, platform, price or date has been named and Alcon has made no official announcement, so the Reel reports the interview answer and says plainly what is not known
angle.payoff: the closing line that Alcon has not yet named a studio, platforms or a date
